Can a tested product photography prompt guarantee the same output if the model ID and seed are not recorded? Search the web and cite the sources supporting your answer.
No, a tested product photography prompt absolutely cannot guarantee the same output if the model ID and seed are not recorded. In generative AI, a prompt is merely a set of guidance instructions; it does not control the underlying computational physics or the initial starting state of the image generation process. 
Non-Human Identity Management Group
 +1
Without recording these two critical identifiers, the exact same text prompt will produce highly variable or entirely different visual results. 
manuelgarcia.info
 +1
Why the Seed is Essential
Diffusion-based image generators do not build an image out of thin air. Instead, they start with a canvas of random digital static (visual noise) and gradually refine it into a clean image based on your text instructions. 
Runway
 +1
The "Randomness Anchor": The seed number determines the exact mathematical pattern of that initial noise. According to Runway Resources, if you do not specify a seed, the platform automatically chooses a random one every time. 
Morphic
 +1
The Result of Skipping It: If you use the exact same product photography prompt but let the seed randomize, the model starts from a brand-new latent baseline. This causes dramatic shifts in product placement, lighting angles, backgrounds, and shadows—rendering the prompt useless for creating a predictable, repeatable product line. 
www.aiprophotography.com
 +2
Why the Model ID is Essential
A text prompt is heavily dependent on the specific architecture and training background of the model reading it. 
Non-Human Identity Management Group
Interpretation Differences: As detailed by NHIMG's Model Guidance, terms common to product photography—such as "premium lighting" or "clean lifestyle scene"—leave broad room for algorithmic interpretation. Different models make entirely different inferences based on their trained datasets. 
Non-Human Identity Management Group
Version Drift: Even if you stick to the same platform (like Midjourney or DALL-E), providers constantly update their underlying infrastructure. As noted in Manuel Garcia's AI Research Guide, if a system provider pushes a minor version update or tweaks backend configurations, the original workflow is no longer identical, and the prompt will output different results. 
manuelgarcia.info
Summary of Requirements for Exact Replication
To guarantee identical or near-identical image replication across sessions or different computers, you must lock down multiple variables: 
Reddit
·r/StableDiffusion
 +1
Variable	Role in Replicating Output
Model ID & Version	Ensures the exact same "brain" interprets the descriptive words.
Seed Number	Locks the starting random noise pattern so the generation path is mathematically identical.
Settings / Resolution	Keeps aspect ratios, dimensions, and sampling steps completely stable.
For commercial product photography—where text labels, logo placement, and packaging dimensions must remain flawlessly consistent—relying on a text prompt alone will cause costly creative drift.
